description.value: Grill Master is a fast-food stall serving Chinese cuisine in the MBC Food Court on Simon Fraser University's Burnaby campus. It sits among several other food court concepts including Ben Gong's Tea, Mad Chicken, and Big Hot. A touring cyclist passing through Burnaby Mountain would find it a convenient stop for a quick meal in a sheltered indoor setting.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands at 45m; stands at 53m.
